Cheese crust & sun-dried tomato bagel made from scratch

Recipe:

  • 3-4c flour
  • 1Tbs sugar
  • 1 1/2tsp salt
  • 1Tbs veg oil
  • 2tsp yeast
  • 1 1/4+/- warm water

Plate with whatever seasoning you want to dip into. Options: Sun-dried tomatoes, olives, or onion bits can be incorporated into dough. Cheese can be grated on top.

  1. Create a soak with yeast, then combine all ingredients once yeast is active.
  2. Knead dough for 10 minutes, or until smooth.
  3. Cut into 6-8 ballz, let rest for 20 minutes.
  4. Roll balls into sneks, long enough to wrap around palm. Roll ends together with palm.
  5. Let rest 20 min, meanwhile boil some water in a pot.
  6. Boil bagels on each side for about 1 minute (or till floating), then dip in seasoning and place on greased baking tray.
  7. Bake on each side for 10 minutes (20 min total) at 425 for perfect roundness.
